sensitivity.formula: F = sum(weight_i for perturbations that change the selected recommendation) / sum(weight_i for all tested perturbations)
sensitivity.interpretation: F measures how fragile the route recommendation is to the tested changes in evidence. It is not an accident probability, a failure probability, or a verified road-safety risk.

suite.description: Perturbations generated from evidence touching the evaluated alternatives: resolve severity>=4 defects (only these affect scoring); remove / verify / un-verify applicable restrictions; close each segment of the recommended route; vehicle height, width and weight at +/-10% where known. Defect verification state is not a routing input and is therefore not in the default suite.
